messages:
marta: FYI we started seeing GPU-host instability after the kernel 6.1 roll to eu-west-1 (gpu pool) this morning. ~15 hosts reporting nvidia modules failing to bind, pods getting evicted.

oz: Which kernel package exactly? any dmesg snippets?

marta: ubuntu 22.04 -> linux-image-6.1.0-22-generic. Drivers: nvidia-driver-535 from apt. Sample dmesg: `NVRM: GPU 0000:65:00:00: rm_init_adapter failed!` and `nvidia: disagrees about version of symbol module_layout`. Also seeing `nvidia_uvm` refuse to register.

samir: That symbol mismatch smells like the kernel modules weren't rebuilt for the new ABI — maybe DKMS hooks didn't run on some nodes. Did cloud-init run fully?

marta: We have a mix: some hosts show `dkms status` OK, others report no nvidia modules installed for current kernel. Boot order shows kernel updated before driver package postinst in a few cases.

jules: Are we seeing NCCL or CUDA errors at the infra layer or just device nodes missing? Any customer-facing impact?

marta: Mixed. For ~40% of affected hosts kubelet evicted GPU pods (OOM-like GPU reset failures). A couple of Dedicated customers in us-west-2 reported degraded throughput on inference clusters (~30% capacity reduction). NCCL hangs seen on multi-GPU nodes that booted partially (some GPUs online, others failing) — jobs stuck with `NCCL WARN TCP :` and hangs in allreduce.

oncall-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-342_GPU_Fleet_KernelIncompat (severity: high)

infra-bot: automated deploy-log: kernel-6.1-rollout started 2026-03-18T08:10Z; targeting eu-west-1-gpu staging->prod. Canary hosts: 8/50 passed validation, 12/50 failed.

oz: Immediate mitigation options: 1) cordon + drain failing nodes and mark as unschedulable for GPU workloads, 2) roll back kernel to previous 5.15 snapshot where available, 3) attempt on-host driver rebuild (`dkms autoinstall` / reinstall nvidia-driver) on canary to see if modules come up.

samir: We should also prevent further auto-upgrades: `apt-mark hold linux-image-generic linux-headers-generic` on pool, and disable kernel-rollout job in infra pipeline until we patch.

jules: On the rebuild path, note we saw earlier that kernel headers for the running kernel are missing on some AMIs — `apt install linux-headers-$(uname -r)` is required before `dkms install`. If headers missing, DKMS won't build.

marta: Tested `dkms autoinstall` on one failed host: it fails with `Error! Bad return status for module build on kernel 6.1.0-22-generic` — digging into module build logs shows `cc1: error: unrecognized command-line option '-mno-fused-madd'` for gcc toolchain mismatch on that image.

oz: Ok that explains the mixed behavior — some AMIs have newer gcc toolchain, some older. We need consistent build environment. Short term: rollback kernels where possible and cordon hosts. Medium term: ensure DKMS run during image bake or switch to prebuilt kernel modules in initramfs.

marta: I'm starting a targeted rollback for eu-west-1 gpu pool — snapshot restore for the 16 worst hosts, will cordon and drain first. Can we freeze kernel upgrades across regions?

samir: I'll patch the rollout job to pause further region promotions and add a preflight DKMS check (verify headers present and `dkms status` post-upgrade).

jules: Also add a kube taint for `gpu-incompat=true:NoSchedule` to protect workloads that are sensitive. We can drain and leave non-critical ops on CPU-only nodes.

infra-bot: automation note: applied taint to nodes: eu-west-1-gpu-*. 12 nodes tainted.

marta: Action items: rollback 16 hosts (marta), pause kernel rollout (samir), bake new AMI with consistent headers+gcc or vendor prebuilt modules (oz), customer comms for dedicated pools (jules).

oz: For the AMI fix, plan: 1) ensure linux-headers and matching gcc installed in bake, 2) run `dkms autoinstall` as part of image build and include built `.ko` in image so boot is self-contained, 3) add smoke tests: `nvidia-smi`, small NCCL allreduce.

samir: Also adding a monitoring alert for `module_layout` symbol mismatch strings in dmesg and `nvidia` module load failures so we catch this earlier.

jules: Customer comms: I'm drafting a short note for impacted Dedicated customers and will include ETA for rollback and mitigations.

marta: Current status: rollback started on 8/16 hosts, 6 restored and re-added to the GPU pool; 2 still in progress. Will post final rollback checklist once done.

oz: Thanks — once rollback complete let's run a controlled canary with rebuilt driver artifacts on 4 hosts before resuming rollout. :thumbsup:

marta: If anyone finds additional dmesg strings, paste here. Also cc @oncall for follow-ups.

oncall-bot: acknowledging incident, oncall alerted: oz (primary), samir (secondary).
